'''August 2000 Las Vegas tournament (19 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas, NV on 19 August 2000. [[Chris Hines]] won it. It is known from Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1147">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-20-las-vegas-19th-mothatrond1147/ las-vegas-19th-mothatron], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 20 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-20-las-vegas-19th-mothatrond1147/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, NV
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Hines]]
